argument: CRISPR systems store fragments of prior invaders and use guide RNAs to direct nucleases to complementary sequences. Reconstituting this programmable recognition with Cas enzymes enables targeted genome cutting and editing.
boundary: Targeting depends on guide complementarity, PAM rules, chromatin accessibility, and nuclease variant.
Off-target cleavage, repair outcomes, delivery, mosaicism, and immune responses limit applications.
Ecological and evolutionary consequences differ from cell-level edit efficiency.
claim: CRISPR systems store fragments of prior invaders and use guide RNAs to direct nucleases to complementary sequences. Reconstituting this programmable recognition with Cas enzymes enables targeted genome cutting and editing.
epistemic_type: CRISPR adaptive immunity and editing principle
interpretation: Programmability is the Meta-Principle; safety and phenotype remain downstream biological questions, not implied by target cleavage.

migration_provenance.source_basics: Studies in the 2000s established CRISPR as adaptive microbial immunity. Jinek and colleagues demonstrated programmable Cas9 cleavage in 2012; Doudna and Charpentier received the 2020 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

title: Sequence Memory Can Guide Programmable Nuclease Defense and Genome Editing

argument: Place cells fire selectively in particular locations or contexts, supporting the idea that hippocampal ensembles encode a relational map rather than only a stimulus–response chain. Population remapping allows different environments or task contexts to occupy distinct internal states.
boundary: Place fields depend on sensory cues, behavior, task, and internal state.
Hippocampal coding extends beyond literal physical space, so “map” is a functional abstraction.
Correlational firing patterns do not alone establish the readout used for behavior.
claim: Place cells fire selectively in particular locations or contexts, supporting the idea that hippocampal ensembles encode a relational map rather than only a stimulus–response chain. Population remapping allows different environments or task contexts to occupy distinct internal states.
interpretation: A child Principle should specify whether “space” is physical, conceptual, temporal, or task-relative and how the map is behaviorally read out.

migration_provenance.source_basics: O’Keefe and Dostrovsky reported hippocampal place cells in 1971. O’Keefe, Moser, and Moser received the 2014 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for the brain’s positioning system.
